scoring_justification: Result-level comparison of the agent-reported threshold fields against the paper's published values with a tolerance of ±0.5 kV/cm. Recomputing the threshold from raw Monte Carlo data is not feasible inside the verifier sandbox; the verifier does not rerun the full simulation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold threshold electric fields for population inversion (Γ2 > Γ1) at 77 K and 300 K.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract: "The population inversion appears in fields exceeding 4 and 5.5 kV cm−1 at 77 and 300 K, respectively."
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published manuscript.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported by the original study; they serve as the hidden gold for result-level comparison.

outputs.description: Lowest lateral electric field at which the relative population of the second Γ subband exceeds that of the first, indicating population inversion, at lattice temperatures 77 K and 300 K.

steps.description: Compare threshold_77K and threshold_300K to the paper's reported gold values with a tolerance of ±0.5 kV/cm. Each correct threshold earns half the score.
